name: CS300X
description:
## Description

"This is a bulb-type pre-main amplifier equivalent to the high-grade version of CS300.The CS300uses EL84manufactured by SOVTEK for the output tube, while the CS300X uses EL84manufactured by 84manufactured by Mullard of England is used.In addition, 5751(12AX7A highly reliable tube) made by General Electric is used for the driver tube.High-grade parts such as RMG resistor, OS capacitor, silk fiber silmic capacitor, etc. are used for the parts. The printed circuit board, which is considered to have a bad influence on sound, is eliminated, and the wiring is completely done by hand with HIFLON lead.It is also equipped with a new output transformer developed for the CS300X.Bus boost circuit is installed.Equipped with a headphone circuit, which is directly output from the output transformer.It has an operation circuit to inform the operation status of the output tube.It says CS300X-Limited, but I think it is the same model."

name: RS-35A
description:
## Description

"A stereo power amplifier using a beam type output tube.The beam-type output tube 5881/6L6GC is used for ultra linear connection.The output stage is self-biased to stabilize its operation and is designed to be less susceptible to aging.Twin triode 6CS7is used for first stage amplification and phase inversion. The first stage is SRPP and the phase inversion is Mulard type.Damper tube 6CG3is used for the rectifier circuit.The 6CG3is a damper tube of 350mA, which does not apply high voltage at once and greatly contributes to the life of the output tube.The output transformer is equipped with a customized energy audio transformer tuned for RS-35a.Hood and spare pipe are included."
